name: Matrix Opti Care Smooth Straight Professional Conditioner | 98gm | Made in India
description:
Product details of Matrix Opti Care Smooth Straight Professional Conditioner | 98gm | Made in India 
Matrix Opti Care Smooth Straight Professional Conditioner 
98gm 
Made in India 
Trusted by hair stylists for Smooth Straight hair. 
Detangles and moisturizes for intense smoothness and shine. 
Nourishes with Shea butter. 
Maintains straightened effect of hair for up to 72 washes. 
Instrumental Test on Straightened hair: 
Shampoo + Conditioner + Serum & a monthly Opti.care Hair Treatment.
